records.name: Painkiller
records.description: Unlocks slow Health Regen in combat.

records.name: Comeback Kid
records.description: +1% Health Regen Rate for each percent of missing Health.

records.name: Speed Junkie
records.description: +60% Health Regen Rate while sprinting.

records.name: Army of One
records.description: +10% Health Regen Rate for each nearby enemy.

records.name: Dorph-head
records.description:
When using Blood Pump Cyberware or a Health Item: 
+100% mitigation chance for 2 sec. 

Mitigation - grants a chance to reduce incoming damage by current Mitigation Strength (default 50%)

records.name: Fury Road
records.description:
In vehicle collisions:
+50% damage to enemy vehicles and their occupants
-50% damage to your vehicles. 

You take no damage as a vehicle occupant in collisions.

records.name: Wrecking Ball
records.description:
Level 1: –15% stamina cost for attacks with blunt weapons. 
Level 2: Allows you to barrel into enemies while sprinting and blocking with blunt weapons, causing damage and a chance to knock them down.

records.name: Fly Swatter
records.description: –40% incoming ranged damage when blocking with blunt weapons.

records.name: Clapback
records.description:
+100% Knockdown chance with Defensive Attacks. 
Cooldown: 10 sec. 

+100% Stun chance with Counterattacks.

records.name: Kinetic Absorption
records.description: Blocking an attack gives +10% stamina and +30% damage with blunt weapons for 5 sec.

records.name: Breakthrough
records.description: –40% enemy armor for 7 sec. after hitting them with a strong attack.

records.name: Die! Die! Die!
records.description:
Level 1: +12.5% Crit Chance at low Stamina.
Level 2: Increased fire rate and improved weapon handling as Stamina decreases.

records.name: Bullet Ballet
records.description: –25% bullet spread when moving.

records.name: Don't Stop Me Now
records.description:
When below 33% Stamina: 
+15% Mitigation Chance, 
+5% Mitigation Strength.

records.name: Like a Feather
records.description: No movement speed penalty with Shotguns, Light Machine Guns and Heavy Machine Guns.

records.name: Quake
records.description:
Level 1: –15% Stamina cost for attacks with Blunt Weapons. 
Level 2: +20% attack speed with Blunt Weapons. 
Level 3: Press [Q] to violently slam the ground, damaging and staggering nearby enemies with a chance of knockdown. 

Quake can also be performed from midair (a superhero landing). 

Cooldown: 10 sec.

records.name: Epicenter
records.description: When Quake is performed from the midair (a Superhero landing), its area of effect and damage scale with your fall speed and fall distance.

records.name: Aftershock
records.description: +30 stamina for each enemy hit with Quake.

records.name: Ripple Effect
records.description: +15% health for each enemy hit by Quake.

records.name: Adrenaline Rush
records.description:
Level 1: +35 Max Health. 
Level 2: +20% Health Regen bonus to all Health Regen effects from all sources. 
Level 3: Unlocks Adrenaline Rush mode. 

In addition to their base effects, Blood Pump cyberware and health items now also give Adrenaline equal to 30% Max Health. (up to a max of 50% Max Health). 

Adrenaline is indicated by a yellow bar and acts like extra health by absorbing damage. It also decays over time.

Adrenaline Rush remains active as long as you have Adrenaline available.

records.name: Calm Mind
records.description: When Adrenaline Rush is active: +3 sec. delay before Adrenaline begins to decay.

records.name: Unstoppable Force
records.description: When Adrenaline Rush is active : gain immunity to movement penalties and non-damaging status effects such as Knockdown, Blinding, etc.

records.name: Juggernaut
records.description:
When Adrenaline Rush is active: 
+20% movement speed, 
+10% damage.

records.name: Bloodlust
records.description: When Adrenaline Rush is active: +50 Adrenaline on dismemberment of a nearby enemy.

records.name: Spontaneous Obliteration
records.description:
Level 1: +12.5% Crit Chance at low Stamina. 
Level 2: +10% damage against nearby enemies. 
Level 3: unlocks Obliterate — the ability to sometimes instantly kill and dismember enemies at low Health. 

The chance increases as enemy Health decreases (max. 20% Obliterate chance).

records.name: Close-quarters Carnage
records.description: Increased chance to Obliterate enemies with ranged attacks at close range (max. 10%).

records.name: Dread
records.description:
–15% enemy armor when using ranged attacks. 

Dismemberment spreads the effect to nearby enemies.

records.name: Skullcracker
records.description: Increases damage of Quick Melee Attacks as Stamina decreases (max. +200% at 0 Stamina)

records.name: Rush of Blood
records.description: +20% reload speed for 8 sec. after dismembering an enemy.

records.name: Finisher: Savage Sling
records.description:
Unlocks a Blunt Weapon Finisher. 

Press [F] when an enemy's Health is low. Enemies affected by Stun are more susceptible.

Restores 20% Health.

Hold [F] to throw the enemy instead, killing them and damaging other enemies where they land.

records.name: Pain to Gain
records.description: When Adrenaline Rush is active: +20% Health Item recharge after neutralizing an enemy.

records.name: Rip and Tear
records.description:
+100% damage for the next Quick Melee Attack after shooting an enemy with a Shotgun.

+100% damage for the next Shotgun shot after hitting an enemy with a Quick Melee Attack.

records.name: Onslaught
records.description: +20% ammo refill after neutralizing an enemy with a Light Machine Gun.

records.name: Slippery
records.description: The faster you move, the more difficult for enemies to shoot you.\n\nEffect increases when Dashing, dodging, sliding, sprinting and vaulting.

records.name: Power Slide
records.description: Increased slide distance.

records.name: Parkour!
records.description: Increased vaulting and climbing speed.

records.name: Muscle Memory
records.description: Allows you to reload weapons while sprinting, sliding and vaulting.

records.name: Multitasker
records.description: Allows you to shoot while sprinting, sliding and vaulting.

records.name: Stuntjock
records.description:
Unlocks preem new ways to exit vehicles:

Jump out - double-tap [F]

Slide out - hold [F] while at high speed

You can also draw and fire weapons during these stunts.

While driving:
No bullet spread penalty from movement
-50% bullet spread overall

records.name: Ready, Rested, Reloaded
records.description:
Level 1: –10% stamina cost for shooting with AR and SMGs. 
Level 2: +30% reload speed when above 50% stamina.

records.name: Mind Over Matter
records.description: –25% recoil when aiming.

records.name: Spice of Life
records.description: +15% weapon swap speed, –30% bullet spread briefly after swapping weapons.

records.name: Tunnel Vision
records.description: +20% effective range and accuracy.

records.name: Dash
records.description:
Level 1: –20% stamina cost for dodging and dashing. 
Level 2: Unlocks the ability to Dash.

Press [LCTRL] to perform a Dash.

Dashing replaces dodging, allowing you to cover more ground and automatically vault over low obstacles.

records.name: Mean Streak
records.description: +40% stamina after neutralizing an enemy while dashing.

records.name: Mad Dash
records.description: +100% dash range toward enemies.

records.name: Steady Grip
records.description: Allows you to shoot while Dashing.

records.name: Can't Touch This
records.description:
+100% mitigation chance when performing a Dash. 

Mitigation grants a chance to reduce incoming damage by current Mitigation Strength (default 50%)

records.name: Flash and Thunderclap
records.description: When performing Strong Attacks, you now automatically leap to enemies within range. These Leap Attacks can be also performed from midair and deal additional damage that scales with the distance of the leap (max +50%).

records.name: Seeing Double
records.description: Increased damage and Stun chance with Counterattacks.

records.name: Bullet Deflect
records.description: When your stamina is above 33% blocking projectiles will Deflect them to wherever your reticle is aimed. Well-timed blocking just before being hit increases the damage you deal with deflected bullets.

records.name: Bullet Time
records.description: Whenever time is slowed, Bullet Deflect does not consume Stamina and deflections automatically hit enemies for Crit Damage.

records.name: Lead and Steel
records.description:
Level 1: –15% stamina cost for attacks with blades. 
Level 2: Unlocks ability to block incoming projectiles with blades. This consumes stamina.

records.name: Finisher: Bladerunner
records.description:
Level 1: -15% Stamina cost for attacks with Blades
Level 2: +20% attack speed with Blades
Level 3: Unlocks a Blade Finisher.

Press [F] when an enemy's Health is low.

Restores 25% Health.

records.name: Going the Distance
records.description: +100% Finisher range

records.name: Opportunist
records.description: Enemies affected by Stagger, Stun, Blinding and Bleeding are more susceptible to Finishers.

records.name: Flash of Steel
records.description: +25% movement speed and attack speed for 6 sec. after performing a Finisher

records.name: Air Dash
records.description:
Level 1: –20% dash stamina cost.
Level 2: +20% dash speed. 
Level 3: Unlocks the ability to dash in midair.

records.name: Aerial Acrobat
records.description: Improves midair maneuverability.

records.name: Aerodynamic
records.description: +30% Mitigation strength in midair.

records.name: Air Kerenzikov
records.description: Activating Kerenzikov in midair keeps you suspended in the air and extends its duration.

records.name: Sharpshooter
records.description:
Level 1: +15% aim speed. 
Level 2: improved weapon control. 
Level 3: each successful shot grants a stack of Sharpshooter. 7% bonus to Stamina Regen Rate and Stamina cost for 2 sec. per stack. Stacks  7 times. New stacks reset duration. All stacks are removed when duration ends.

records.name: Gundancer
records.description: Aiming no longer slows movement.\n\nAllows you to shoot while vaulting.

records.name: Practice Makes Perfect
records.description: +7% Crit Chance and Crit Damage per stack of Sharpshooter.

records.name: Spray and Pray
records.description: –10% Stamina cost for hip-firing.

records.name: Shoot to Chill
records.description: +4% Armor penetration for automatic weapons per stack of Sharpshooter.

records.name: Slaughterhouse
records.description: All attacks, counterattacks and deflected bullets apply Bleeding, which increases dismemberment chance. Bleeding cannot kill enemies, but does make them more susceptible to Finishers. +25 stamina from dismemberments.

records.name: Tailwind
records.description: +25 stamina from performing Air Dashes and double jumps.

records.name: Submachine Fun
records.description: Swapping Submachine Guns is faster and automatically reloads them, +22% fire rate after swapping to an SMG. Normal reloading ends the effect.

records.name: Salt in the Wound
records.description: Shooting the same target 7 consecutive times deals bonus damage equal to 100% of the total damage from those shots.

records.name: All Things Cyber
records.description:
Level 1: +10% to all cyberware stats modifiers
Level 2: -20% Cyberware Capacity cost for cyberware in the Integumentary System and Skeleton

records.name: Chrome Constitution
records.description: -5% incoming damage if all Integumentary System and Skeleton cyberware slots are filled

records.name: Lucky Day
records.description: +25% crafting components from looting.

records.name: Renaissance Punk
records.description: +4 Cyberware Capacity for each Attribute at 9 or higher

records.name: Driver Update
records.description: All cyberware gain an additional stat modifier.

records.name: Chipware Connoisseur
records.description:
When upgrading cyberware, you can choose from two stat modifier options.

A third option is available at Tier 3 and higher.

records.name: Gearhead
records.description:
+33% vehicle health
Vehicle-mounted weapons receive:
+25% damage
-0,7 sec. lock-on time

records.name: Health Freak
records.description:
Level 1: +8% recharge speed for Health Items and grenades.
Level 2: +1 health item charge, 
+150% recharge speed for health items outside combat.

records.name: Transfusion
records.description: +30% health from the final charge of your equipped health item.

records.name: First Aid
records.description: +15% recharge speed of Health Items when you've only used 1 charge.

records.name: Glutton for War
records.description: 5% instant recharge of Health items and grenades after neutralizing an enemy.

records.name: Demolitions Surplus
records.description: +1 max grenade charge, +250% recharge speed for grenades outside of combat.

records.name: Field Medic
records.description: 15% faster use of Health Items in combat.

records.name: Borrowed Time
records.description: +100% instant recharge of a health item after neutralizing an enemy if you are below 25% health and have no charges remaining.

records.name: Coming in Hot
records.description: +50% recharge speed for grenades when you have none available.

records.name: Bolt
records.description:
Level 1: +20% charge speed for tech weapons. 
Level 2: +15% damage for charged shots with tech weapons. 
Level 3: Unlocks Bolt shots. To fire a Bolt, release the trigger for a charged shot right before it fully charges: counts as a fully charged shot, +30% damage, –50% penalty for penetrating cover.

Full-auto Tech weapons fire Bolts in a short burst. To continue firing Bolts in full-auto, press and hold the trigger again after firing the initial burst.

records.name: In Charge
records.description: Tech weapons no longer fire automatically when reaching full charge.

records.name: Shock Value
records.description: Bolt shots ignore enemy Armor.

records.name: Internal Clock
records.description: Increased time window to fire a Bolt.

records.name: Lightning Storm
records.description: +10% charge speed after firing a Bolt. Stacks 3 times. Swapping weapons or firing a non-Bolt shot resets the stack.

records.name: License to Chrome
records.description:
Level 1: +10% to all cyberware stat modifiers. 
Level 2: +40 armor. 
Level 3: unlocks a new cyberware slot for the skeleton. All skeleton cyberware have boosted stats.

records.name: Extended Warranty
records.description: +15% duration for all cyberware effects.

records.name: Built Different
records.description: Unlocks Cellular Adapter cyberware for the Integumentary System. It can be purchased and installed at ripperdoc clinics. This Perk is required to use it properly.

records.name: Ambidextrous
records.description: Unlocks a new cyberware slot for your Hands.

records.name: Cyborg
records.description: 15% reduced Cooldown for all cyberware if all available slots are filled.

records.name: Doomlauncher
records.description:
Projectile Launch System cyberware receives: 
+1 max charges, 
+20% recharge speed, 
+25% additional recharge speed when you have no charges available, 
+200% additional recharge speed outside of combat.
+5% instant recharge after neutralizing an enemy. 

It also receives the same bonus as grenades from Burn This City Perk.

records.name: Pyromania
records.description:
Level 1: +8% recharge speed for health items and grenades. 
Level 2: +10% explosion radius for grenades and the Projectile Launch System.
Level 3: +5% movement speed and +10% explosion damage for 12 sec. after hitting an enemy in combat with an explosion from a grenade, explosive device or Projectile Launch System. If you take damage from the explosion, the effect adds 2 stacks instead of 1. Effect stacks 5 times.

records.name: Friendlier Fire
records.description: +50% resistance to damage and effects from explosions you cause.

records.name: Flash Sale
records.description: For Flash, Smoke and Recon grenades:\nDouble grenade charges\nDouble recharge rate

records.name: Burn This City
records.description: When you accumulate 5 stacks of Pyromania, they will be consumed to instantly replenish a grenade charge, but all bonuses from those stacks will remain active for 6 sec.

records.name: Heat Shield
records.description: +10% Mitigation Chance per stack of Pyromania.

records.name: Chain Lightning
records.description: Bolt now deals Electrical damage and releases an electric arc that can electrocute up to 3 nearby enemies.

records.name: Edgerunner
records.description:
Allows you to exceed your cyberware capacity by up to 50 points, but at the cost of -0.5% max health per point over capacity. 

When you neutralize an enemy during combat, there is a 0.1% chance for each point you are over capacity that you you will break into a Fury. 
In this state, you gain: 
+10% damage, 
+30% critical chance, 
+50% critical damage. 

Duration: 12 sec. 
+3 sec. duration for each neutralization while Fury is active.

records.name: Ticking Time Bomb
records.description: Charges powerful EMP that hits nearby enemies after 3 sec. Whenever you activate Operating System cyberware (Berserk, Sandevistan) or Overlock. Applies Stun and deal damage proportionate to the quantity and tier of cyberware implants you have installed, –50% incoming damage while charging EMP.

records.name: Power Surge
records.description: Activating Overclock instantly restores Health equal to 5 times your max RAM.

records.name: Eye in the Sky
records.description:
Automatically highlights nearby Access Points and cameras. 

When uploaded through camera, Control quickhacks, Covert quickhacks and the Distract Enemies quickhack have: –1 RAM cost, +50% duration.

records.name: Warning: Explosion Hazard
records.description: +40% explosion damage from hacked devices, +80% additional explosion damage to enemies affected by quickhacks (including Distract Enemies)

records.name: ForceKill Cypher
records.description: Reduces sequence length required to hack Access Points by 1.\n\nTotal sequence length cannot be reduced below 2 characters.

records.name: Carhacker
records.description: Unlocks Vehicle quickhacks, allowing you to remotely take control, set off alarms or even blow them up.\n\nThe availability of a given quickhack depends on the Tier of your installed cyberdeck.

records.name: Optimization
records.description: +35% RAM recovery rate.

records.name: Proximate Propagation
records.description: Reduced RAM cost the closer you are to the target (max –35%).

records.name: Encryption
records.description: -30% traceability for all quickhacks.

records.name: Subordination
records.description: +100% duration for Control quickhacks used on full-health enemies.

records.name: Hack Queue
records.description:
Level 1: +1 Max RAM. 
Level 2: unlocks quickhacks queues, allowing 2 quickhacks on a single enemy. Queued quickhacks automatically upload in the order they are added, +30% upload speed for the second quickhack in a queue.

records.name: Counter-a-hack
records.description:
When you're the target of an enemy netrunner, you are now able to counter quickhack them through walls and obstacles.

-1 RAM cost for such counter quickhacks.

records.name: Copy-Paste
records.description: When you're the target of an enemy netrunner, using a quickhack against them will also spread the quickhack's effect to their allies.

records.name: Data Recycler
records.description: After neutralizing an enemy, recover 80% of the RAM cost from all quickhacks remaining in their queue.

records.name: Feedback Loop
records.description: +25% RAM recovery rate for each quickhack currently in a queue.

records.name: Embedded Exploit
records.description:
Level 1: +10% RAM recovery rate. 
Level 2: +60% quickhack damage against enemies affected by Control quickhacks, Covert quickhacks or the Distract Enemies quickhack.

records.name: ICEpick
records.description: –1 RAM cost for Combat quickhacks used on enemies affected by or targeted  Control quickhacks, Covert quickhacks or the Distract Enemies quickhack.

records.name: Shadowrunner
records.description: –100% trace progress after performing a Takedown.

records.name: Siphon
records.description: Monowire attacks recover 0.5 RAM. Increases to 1 if the enemy is affected by or targeted by a quickhack.

records.name: System Overwhelm
records.description: +7% quickhack damage for each unique quickhack and DOT effect affecting the target.

records.name: Speculation
records.description: Neutralizing an enemy with a Combat quickhack recovers RAM equal to 25% of the total cost of all quickhacks affecting the target.

records.name: Recirculation
records.description: +2 RAM after neutralizing an enemy with a Smart weapon. If the enemy is affected by quickhacks, restores additional RAM equal to 50% of their total RAM cost.

records.name: Acquisition Specialist
records.description:
Level 1: 10% larger target reticle for smart weapons. 
Level 2: reloading smart weapons no longer interrupts target lock, 
+15 lock-on speed when hip-firing, 
+20% lock-on speed when aiming.

records.name: Precision Subroutines
records.description: +2% accuracy with smart weapons for each unit in your cyberdeck’s max RAM.

records.name: No Escape
records.description: When using Smart weapons, if the target lock on an enemy is about to end, shooting them resets it.

records.name: Target Lock Transfer
records.description:
Level 1: 10% larger targeting reticle for smart weapons. 
Level 2: switching from aiming to hip-fire does not disengage target-lock on headshots and weakspots. 
Level 3: switching from one smart weapon to another no longer interrupts target lock.

records.name: Targeting Prism
records.description: Enables multiple target locks when aiming and increases the number of simultaneous targets for all smart weapons by 1.

records.name: Terminal Velocity
records.description: Increased projectile velocity and lock-on range for 10 sec. after neutralizing an enemy with smart weapon. Stacks 3 times. New stacks reset duration. All stacks are removed when duration ends.

records.name: Overclock
records.description:
Level 1: +10% RAM recovery rate. 
Level 2: +10% quickhack damage. 
Level 3: Unlocks Overclock mode.

If you have a cyberdeck installed, press [E] to activate. In this mode, you can use quickhacks even with insufficient RAM, but each RAM unit over your max costs 10 Health instead.

Duration: 14 sec.
Cooldown: 30 sec.

records.name: Race Against Mind
records.description: When Overlock is active: increased quickhack damage as health decreases (max +50%). Health is measured when you begin upload.

records.name: Sublimation
records.description: When Overclock is active, all RAM recovery effects also regenerate Health.

records.name: Blood Daemon
records.description: When Overlock is active: +40 health for each quickhack queued on an enemy at the time you neutralize them.

records.name: Queue Acceleration
records.description:
Level 1: +1 max RAM. 
Level 2: –1 RAM cost to quickhack devices and vehicles. 
Level 3: +1 quickhack queue size, +60 upload speed for quickhack third or later in the queue.

records.name: Queue Hack_Root
records.description: –1 RAM cost for the first quickhack of each unique category (Covert, Combat, Control) second or later in the queue.

records.name: Queue Prioritization
records.description: +50% upload speed for the first quickhack when you have at least 2 quickhacks queued on an enemy.

records.name: Finisher: Live Wire
records.description:
Unlocks a Monowire Finisher.

Press [F] when an enemy's Health is low.

The more quickhacks you have queued on an enemy, the more susceptible they are.

Restores 15% Health and 5 RAM.

records.name: Smart Synergy
records.description: When Overlock is active, smart weapons gain instant target lock, and +25% damage if the enemy is affected by a quickhack.

records.name: Spillover
records.description: When Overlock is active: +50% chance for quickhacks to spread to an additional target.

records.name: Queue Mastery
records.description: +1 quickhack queue size. The last quickhack to fill a queue has –50% RAM cost and locks the queue until all quickhacks have uploaded., +15% damage against enemies with a locked queue.

records.name: Road Warrior
records.description:
Allows you to use Sandevistan to slow time while driving.

Allows Kerenzikov to be activated when aiming and handbraking simultaneously.

+25% weapon damage when your vehicle is drifting or airborne.

records.name: Feline Footwork
records.description:
When crouched: 
+15% Movement Speed, 
+15 Mitigation Chance. 

Mitigation grants a chance to reduce incoming damage by current Mitigation Strength (default 50%).

records.name: Unexposed
records.description: +20% Mitigation Chance when aiming from cover.

records.name: Small Target
records.description: +20% Mitigation Chance when crouched and not moving.

records.name: Blind Spot
records.description: When crouched, the higher your Mitigation Chance, the longer it takes for enemies to detect you.

records.name: Killer Instinct
records.description: +25% damage with knives, axes and silenced guns outside of combat. They also provide a preview of estimated damage.

records.name: Gag Order
records.description: Landing an attack on an enemy right after they detect you will delay detection from other nearby enemies.

records.name: Quick Getaway
records.description: +10% movement speed after neutralizing an enemy while undetected. Duration: 30 sec or until detected. Stacks 2 times. New stacks reset duration. All stacks are removed when duration ends.

records.name: Scorpion Sting
records.description:
Level 1: –15% recovery time for throwable weapons. 
Level 2: Critical hits, headshots and hits to weak spots with throwable weapons apply poison for 5 sec.

records.name: Corrosion
records.description: Allows you to apply Poison to mechs, robots, drones and turrets.

records.name: Accelerated Toxin Absorption
records.description: Strong Attacks and thrown weapons used against Poisoned enemies instantly deal substantial Poison damage then remove all Poison effects.

records.name: Neurotoxin
records.description: Applying poison to an enemy via Scorpion Sting now also applies bleeding and disables sprinting for 6 sec.

records.name: Parasite
records.description: +15 Health on Crit Hits and headshots with thrown weapons.

records.name: Focus
records.description:
Level 1: +10% headshot and weak spot damage. 
Level 2: Unlocks Focus mode. This mode automatically activates when you aim while at full Stamina.

When active:
No Stamina cost for shooting, allowing for more accurate shots.

When it ends:
-40 Stamina

Duration: 2.5 sec.

records.name: Head to Head
records.description: When Focus is active, neutralizing an enemy with a ranged attack resets its duration.

records.name: Pull!
records.description: When Focus is active, shooting grenades out of the air is easier and the blast is more powerful.

records.name: Deep Breath
records.description: Time slows by 25% for you and enemies when Focus is active.

records.name: Rinse and Reload
records.description: +10 reload speed for your next reload after neutralizing an enemy while aiming. Stacks 2 times. The stack resets to 0 whenever you start aiming.

records.name: No Sweat
records.description: –50% stamina cost from Focus for each enemy neutralized while it was active.

records.name: Juggler
records.description:
Level 1: –15% recovery time for throwable weapons. 
Level 2: +20% headshot and weak spot damage with throwable weapons. 
Level 3: Instant Cooldown reset for all throwable weapons after neutralizing an enemy with a throwable weapon via headshot, Crit Hit, or Poison.

records.name: Pay It Forward
records.description: After retrieving a thrown knife or axe from an enemy, your first melee attack with a throwable weapons gains +200% damage.

records.name: Finisher: Act of Mercy
records.description:
Unlocks a Throwable Weapon Finisher.

Press [F] when an enemy's Health is low.

Automatically activates Juggler.

Restores 25% Health.

records.name: Sleight of Hand
records.description: +20% critical damage for 8 sec whenever Juggler is activated. Stack 5 times. New stacks reset duration. All stacks are removed when duration ends.

records.name: Pounce
records.description:
Allows you to perform Finishers from a greater distance if you've hit the enemy with a throwable weapon.

Each successful throw also makes them more susceptible to Finishers.

To perform a Finisher, press [F] when an enemy's Health is low.

records.name: Ninjutsu
records.description:
Level 1: +15% crouch movement speed. 
Level 2: +15% mitigation chance when crouched. 
Level 3: Unlocks the ability to sprint while crouching.

Press [LSHIFT] while crouching.

Crouch-sprinting allows you to move more quickly while staying silent, but it consumes Stamina.

records.name: Serpentine
records.description: +30% mitigation chance when crouch-sprinting.

records.name: Creeping Death
records.description: When optical camo is active or you are undetected, neutralizing an enemy grants: +15% health, +15% stamina, +10% movement speed for 6 sec.

records.name: Shinobi Sprint
records.description: –75% stamina cost for crouch-sprinting during combat.

records.name: Vanishing Act
records.description: Optical Camo activates automatically and consumes its charge gradually while crouch-sprinting or sliding

records.name: Deadeye
records.description:
Level 1: +10% headshot and weak spot damage. 
Level 2: –25% stamina cost for shooting. 
Level 3: unlocks Deadeye mode, which is active above 85% stamina. When active: +25% headshot damage, +25% weak spot damage, no bullet spread.

records.name: Quick Draw
records.description: +30% weapon swap speed when swapping to pistols, revolvers, sniper rifles and precision rifles, +30% Stamina when swapping during combat.

records.name: Long Shot
records.description: When Deadeye is active, your shots always deal full damage regardless of distance.

records.name: High Noon
records.description:
When Deadeye is active: 
+35% reload speed for your next reload after neutralizing an enemy via headshot or weak spot. Effect available for 3 sec. 
Slows time by 50% during reload.

records.name: California Reaper
records.description: +30% stamina after neutralizing an enemy with a ranged attack via headshot or weak spot.

records.name: Nerves of Tungsten-Steel
records.description: When Deadeye is active: guaranteed critical hits for headshots and weak spots, increased damage as distance increases (max +25%).

records.name: Run 'N' Gun
records.description: Hip-firing does not consume stamina. When Focus is active +25% movement speed.

records.name: Style Over Substance
records.description: Guaranteed Crit Hits with thrown attacks when crouch-sprinting, sliding, dodging or Dashing; also from motorcycles when airborne, drifting or dismounting via jump. No movement speed penalty when aiming a throwable weapon.

records.name: Double Trouble
records.description:
Level 1: Unlocks the ability to dual wield, but each weapon deals -37.5% damage.
When aiming:
-15% recoil
-15% bullet spread
Simultaneous shooting with both weapons.
Level 2: Press [Q] to perform a Heywood Hurricane, automatically firing both dual-wield weapons for 1 sec. but with +50% bullet spread.
Ammo spent on successful shots is automatically refilled.
Replaces Quick Melee Attack.

records.name: Keep 'Em Comin'
records.description:
+15 Stamina after neutralizing an enemy when dual wielding.

+15 additional Stamina per stack of Triple Tequila.

records.name: Triple Tequila
records.description:
+10% Mitigation Chance after neutralizing an enemy when dual wielding.
Duration: 15 sec.
Stacks 3 times.

Triple Tequila stacks are consumed when performing a Heywood Hurricane, giving it +15% damage per stack.
Note: Stacks cannot be earned during a Heywood Hurricane.

records.name: Two Right Hands
records.description:
When hip-firing with dual wield:
-25% Stamina cost

When aiming with dual wield:
-20% recoil
-20% bullet spread

records.name: Splash of Love
records.description:
+50% fire rate for Heywood Hurricane.

At max stacks of Triple Tequila:
+1 sec. duration for Heywood Hurricane.

records.name: Jailbreak
records.description:
Unlocks new abilities for Arm cyberware: Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Projectile Launch System and Monowire.

You can now overcharge the Projectile Launch System by holding Middle Mouse Button. This launches a burst of 5 projectiles that cover a larger area.

Attacking with Gorilla Arms now charges them up. When fully charged, a Strong Attack deals massive damage and creates a shockwave, staggering nearby enemies.

Neutralizing an enemy this way will send their body flying.

Dismembering an enemy or performing a Finisher with Mantis Blades will charge the next Leap Attack.

Hold Left Mouse Button and release to perform a long-range Leap Attack.

A charged Leap Attack with Mantis Blades has +30 m. longer reach and deals massive damage with a wide slash that hits the target and other nearby enemies.

Killing an enemy with this attack also dismembers them.

The Monowire now has a dedicated slot for Control quickhacks.

To use the installed quickhack, charge the Monowire by holding Left Mouse Button. When fully charged, release the attack to deal damage and upload the quickhack without paying its RAM cost.

records.name: Launch Capacity Override
records.description: Increases the number of Projectile Launch System charges by 1.

records.name: Emergency Cloaking
records.description:
Improves Optical Camo cyberware.

Activating Optical Camo during combat by pressing [Middle mouse button] will cause enemies to lose track of you, giving you a chance to exit combat.

Note: To use this ability, you must have Optical Camo equipped to your Combat Gadget quickslot.

records.name: Vulnerability Analytics
records.description:
During combat, you can now detect Vulnerabilities in enemy Armor and cyberware. Hitting Vulnerabilities gives:

100% Crit Chance
+25% Armor penetration
Weakspot damage bonuses

Dealing enough damage to a Vulnerability will cause it to explode, generating an EMP blast that damages enemies within 3 m.

records.name: Machine Learning
records.description:
Destroying an enemy's Vulnerability grants:
+10% frequency of new Vulnerabilities appearing
+5% Crit Damage against Vulnerabilities

Duration: 25 sec.
Effect and duration can stack 5 times. 
Reaching max stacks doubles these effects.

records.name: Limiter Removal
records.description: The shockwave from a charged Gorilla Arms attack now knocks down all enemies within range.

records.name: Spatial Mapping
records.description: All Leap Attacks with Mantis Blades now cripple enemies and increase dismemberment chance against those same enemies for 10 sec.

records.name: Data Tunneling
records.description: When an enemy is affected by a Monowire-uploaded quickhack, normal Monowire attacks which hit that enemy and other enemies simultaneously will spread the quickhack to them.

records.name: Sensory Protocol
records.description: When crouched, being detected by an enemy will temporarily slow down. Dodge or Dash out of the enemy's line of sight to immediately exit combat. Cooldown 120 sec.
